name: Pennsylvania

sources.title: PA DOR — Employer Withholding, personal income tax rate

flatRate.comment: Pennsylvania has no personal exemptions, no standard deduction and no withholding allowances. Withholding is a straight percentage of PA-taxable compensation.

exemptComment: Deliberately omits deferral_401k / 403b / 457 / SIMPLE. Pennsylvania taxes elective retirement deferrals as compensation when earned, unlike federal income tax. An engine with a single shared 'taxable wages' figure gets Pennsylvania wrong on every cheque where an employee defers.
knownGaps: PA employee unemployment (UC) withholding is not modelled — rate not yet verified from a primary source.
Act 32 local Earned Income Tax (EIT) and Local Services Tax (LST) require PSD-code resolution; see README.
